description: Implementation of an in-memory cache with methods for setting, getting, and managing cache entries, including TTL handling and eviction policies.

classes.name: InMemoryCache
classes.description: A cache class that stores data in memory with TTL and eviction policies.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the cache with optional max size, TTL, and per-item size limits.

methods.name: check_value_size
methods.description: Checks if a value exceeds the maximum allowed size for cache storage.

methods.name: _is_key_expired
methods.description: Checks if a specific cache key has expired based on TTL.

methods.name: _remove_key
methods.description: Removes a key from cache and TTL dictionaries.

methods.name: evict_cache
methods.description: Evicts expired or least recently expiring items to maintain cache size limits.

methods.name: allow_ttl_override
methods.description: Determines if TTL can be overridden for a specific key.

methods.name: set_cache
methods.description: Sets a cache entry with optional TTL.

methods.name: async_set_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a cache entry.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Asynchronously sets multiple cache entries in a pipeline.

methods.name: async_set_cache_sadd
methods.description: Adds multiple values to a set stored in cache.

methods.name: evict_element_if_expired
methods.description: Removes a cache element if it has expired.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry, returning None if expired or not found.

methods.name: batch_get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache entries.

methods.name: increment_cache
methods.description: Increments a numeric cache value.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cache entry.

methods.name: async_batch_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple cache entries.

methods.name: async_increment
methods.description: Asynchronously increments a numeric cache value.

methods.name: async_increment_pipeline
methods.description: Performs multiple asynchronous increments in a pipeline.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Clears all cache entries.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Placeholder for disconnect logic.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache entry.

methods.name: async_get_ttl
methods.description: Retrieves remaining TTL for a cache key.

methods.name: async_get_oldest_n_keys
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest n keys based on TTL.
